description: A Textile Post Processing Machine Operator is responsible to do the specified job of post processing dyed /bleached, RFD fabric with proper control of parameters to get the desired effect. This job requires the individual to have thorough knowledge of process flow and material flow in a processing mill for fabric production and should know the important functions and operations of textile post processing Machines.
